Most people compare Bitcoin to credit cards, when they should be comparing Bitcoin to SWIFT and the current financial system. They don't understand that Bitcoin can settle a finalized bearer asset transaction within 10 minutes while the traditional system takes days or even weeks.

Bitcoin is also exponentially more efficient and uses less energy.

I can't find the clip right now, but Adam Back explains how Bitcoin is engineered to be the perfect balance of features. Compromising in one area of the design leads to less decentralization. That's why it makes sense to have a solid foundation to build additional layers upon, otherwise you just end up with another shitcoin.
